description: Repairs r-fmt-2b/dl-pg-empty-ladder: no public read between steps (only the whole-file hash existed for the middle steps). Deletes until a page empties: Pg ID 1, 2, 3 and 4 are deleted by four single statements, then one full-size row (ID 21, eight fields of 61 U+20AC) is inserted. Asks which delete empties the page, what each earlier delete changes, and whether the insert reuses the emptied page; after every step the closed file is kept and the lengths of Pg are read back through a read-only open. Pg: 12 rows, ID and eight Text(255) fields T1..T8, each holding 61 repetitions of U+20AC (122 UTF-16 bytes of value; the character lies outside Latin-1). Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
